## viaPanel 3.0.0 - Minecraft 26.2 port

Port of the annotation-based panel API to the new Minecraft line.

### Toolchain
- Minecraft **26.2** (official Mojang mappings, Loom 1.17, Gradle 9.5.1)
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3, Fabric API 0.152.1+26.2
- **Java 25** required

### API compatibility
Public `com.viameowts.viapanel.api` package: class/method names unchanged (`@ViaPanelField`, `ViaPanelProviders.builder`, `ViaPanelApi`). MC types in signatures now use Mojang mappings (`CommandSourceStack`, `Component`, ...) - consumers must be ported to the same target to compile against this jar.

Consumers staying on MC 1.21.11 keep using viapanel `2.9.0`.

### Internal adaptations
- Permission system moved to `PermissionSet` / `Permission.HasCommandLevel`
- Brigadier/Mojmap renames (`Commands`, `CommandSourceStack.sendFailure/sendSuccess`)
- Click/Hover events remain record-style

## viaPanel API 2.9.0 - annotation-based configuration

### Added
- `@ViaPanelField` annotation for config fields: display names (EN/RU), hover descriptions, sections, inclusive numeric `min`/`max` validation, sort order, `secret` masking
- Supported field types: `boolean`, `int`, `long`, `float`, `double`, `String`, `enum` (click cycles values)
- `ViaPanelProviders.builder(modId, displayName, config)` factory with optional hooks: `permission`, `onFieldUpdated`, `languageHook`, `onReload`
- Automatic reload: the core finds a no-arg `load()` method and copies annotated fields into the live instance - manual field copying is gone
- Save failures are now reported in-game instead of being silently swallowed
- Bilingual UI resolved from global language (`/viapanel lang ru|en`) via `valueRu` / `descRu`

### Changed
- Removed `defaultLanguage` hardcode from the command core - providers own their language reactions
- Duplicate provider registration now logs a warning

### Migration
- Legacy `ViaPanelProvider` remains fully supported (HelperHelper, viaLogium keep using it)
- Consumers must depend on the panel via `fileTree(dir: '../lib', include: 'viapanel-*.jar')` instead of pinned jar names
- Full docs and migration checklist: [VIAPANEL_API.md](https://github.com/viaMeowts/viapanel/blob/main/VIAPANEL_API.md)

**Requires:** Minecraft 1.21.11, Fabric Loader 0.18.4, Java 21

## [2.7.2] - 2026-06-27

### Added
- ViaPanelConfig -- TOML-based config loader/saver for viaPanel settings
- ViaPanelPermissionHelper -- LuckPerms integration via reflection with OP level fallback
- Global language switcher in main /viapanel menu with [EN] / [RU] clickable buttons
- Permission-gated /viapanel lang command with configurable permission node
- hasGlobalAdminPermission() helper to gate global language changes

### Changed
- Color palette migrated from viaStyle to viaPanel palette (accent #FFC64C, success #98FB98, error #FF5555, secondary #B0C4DE)
- defaultLanguage field update now requires global admin permission
- README fully rewritten; .gitignore expanded; version 2.6.8 -> 2.7.2

### Removed
- VIAPANEL_API.md (API docs now in README)

### Security
- /viapanel lang now enforces permission check before execution
